==Biography==

LvMao spent some time on LSPL teams which included [[Star Horn Royal Club]], [[ZTR Gaming]] and [[Now or Never]]. He never achieved particularly good results with any of those teams and did not qualify for the LPL. He left Now Or Never and joined the newly formed [[JD Gaming]] in May of 2017. Their first showing was at the [[Demacia_Cup/2017_Season|2017 Demacia Cup]] but it wasn't particularly good as they placed 9th-12th after an 0-2 loss to [[LGD Gaming]]. In the [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Season|2017 LPL Summer Season]] JD Gaming finished 5th in Group B with 6 wins and 11 losses which eliminated them from playoff contention. They also placed 2nd at the [[National Electronic Sports Tournament 2017]].

==Career Highlights and Awards==
* LPL Champion (2020 Spring)
* LPL Finals MVP (2020 Spring)
* LPL All-Pro 2nd Team (2020 Spring)

== Trivia ==
* His surname '''Zuo''' (左) is an uncommon surname in China.
* MVP of the [[LPL/2020 Season/Spring Playoffs|LPL 2020 Spring Finals]].
* Married Chinese idol group member "''Xia Yue''" on September 30, 2021.
=== Statistics ===
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on March 14th, 2021.
** Was the 12th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL after [[Clearlove]], [[Pyl (Chen Bo)|Pyl]], [[meiko]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[COLD]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[Baolan]], [[Doinb]], [[Flandre]], and [[Crisp]].
* Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on August 21st, 2022.
** The 9th player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL, after [[meiko]], [[Pyl (Chen Bo)|Pyl]], [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], [[xiaohu]], [[Rookie]], [[cold]], [[Doinb]], and [[Crisp]].
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on June 25, 2023
** The 20th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
